item.title: Libya: the situation
item.description:
Ukrainian naval drones have struck two Russian vessels at Libya's Benghazi naval base and off its coast, sinking one warship and damaging another, extending a series of drone attacks on Russian ships in Libyan waters. Libyan forces continue shelling Haftar positions while some Haftar militia have surrendered at a strategic airbase, and Turkish officials have publicly welcomed a motion supporting the troops. An armed group blocked the Hamada oil pipeline for over 20 days, causing $31 million in losses for the National Oil Corporation. The conflict still recorded 2 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
